name: vJailbreak
description: A migration appliance that copies virtual machines from VMware vCenter into Private Cloud Director: discovery, network and storage mapping, and cold or accelerated disk copy, driven from a web UI.

configuration.label: Admin Password
configuration.help: For the ubuntu user (console and SSH); at least 8 characters.

post_deploy_notes: Open the UI and enter vCenter and PCD credentials. The VM's network must reach vCenter, the ESXi hosts and the PCD API endpoints.
todo: Sizing is m1.xlarge-class per the docs; disk size (60 GB) and UI port (80) need confirming.
Static addressing assumes the interface is ens3 (default i440fx machine type); net.mac is available if that changes.
Must boot from volume (a *.vol flavor) so it can attach more volumes during migrations.
